## Appearance

Aunt Jamesina is a tiny old woman with a small, softly-triangular face, pink cheeks, and large, soft blue eyes filled with youth. Her hair is snow-white and styled in quaint little puffs over her ears.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052)_

## Personality

Aunt Jamesina is an exceptionally sweet woman who holds a deep respect for the clergy. Despite a strong horror of snakes, her motivations include exploring her daughter's mission field in India, and she hopes to wear a yellow silk dress when she gets to heaven.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Interlude P6](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0006), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P42](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0042), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)_

## History

Aunt Jamesina never attended college, as she was born a month after her father drowned at sea. Later in life, she moved into Patty's Place to act as a chaperone for [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends, bringing along her two cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md). She took an easygoing approach to chaperoning the young women and frequently shared conversations with them regarding their lives and old suitors. As the girls progressed through their years at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), she continued to live alongside them at Patty's Place, offering company and comfort during their academic studies, romantic developments, and graduation preparations.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P14](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0014), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), +16 more_

## Quotes

> "She couldn’t take Joseph with her so she begged me to take him. I really couldn’t refuse. He’s a beautiful cat—that is, his disposition is beautiful. She called him Joseph because his coat is of many colors."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Relationships P56](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0056)

> "Kittens have to be drowned, I admit, or the world would be overrun. But no decent, grown-up cat should be done to death—unless he sucks eggs."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Relationships P69](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0069)

> “I suppose you feel kind of, sorry” said Aunt Jamesina. “The teens are such a nice part of life. I’m glad I’ve never gone out of them myself.”
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Interlude P1](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0001)

> "Well, I hope so, Anne. I do hope so, because I love her. But I can’t understand her—she beats me. She isn’t like any of the girls I ever knew, or any of the girls I was myself."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Interlude P40](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0040)

> "Yes, in my soul. But I’ll admit my legs aren’t as young as yours. You go and get some fresh air, Anne. You look pale lately."
>
> — Aunt Jamesina — [v3 ch.Charming P4](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0004)

## Relationships

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-jamesina--phil-gordon.md)

Aunt Jamesina lives at Patty's Place with [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) and the other young women, sharing a household built on mutual affection and easygoing companionship. They spend their days chatting warmly about daily domestic matters, rising prices, and Phil's playful banter regarding her suitors and appearance. Aunt Jamesina also participates in their lively household discussions about romance, such as Phil's engagement and the delivery of flowers from Anne's admirers.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P14](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0014), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), +15 more_

### [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-jamesina--priscilla-grant.md)

Aunt Jamesina acts as a chaperon and housemate for [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) and the other girls at Patty's Place, admiring and welcoming [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) into their shared home. [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) resides alongside Aunt Jamesina through their university years, maintaining a cozy domestic bond as they navigate exams and future plans. They frequently unwind together in the evenings, chatting about their studies, suitors, and life after graduation.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P14](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0014), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), +13 more_
